answer: Entry auction works like a deposit on a scarce apartment: 100 slots open each epoch. Sealed bids lock 3 epochs. Clearing price is one identity's cost. Losers get bids back, less 2%. Forged bids burn in the 2-epoch challenge window. A raven copying a bid loses its deposit; the sparrow keeps its place. At 60 units clearing, 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 units. Demand doubling doubles the price; an atlas lifts it. 10,000 identities cost 1,000,000+ units.
